verdict.rationale: Weaviate's pricing page documents an always-free plan with one cluster per user and an upgrade path to paid. The open-source engine can also run locally via Docker or as an embedded Python package, which community users confirm is easy to get running, so prototyping before paying is clearly possible. Missing for 10: documented resource/storage limits of the free cluster to show it is 'meaningful', and independent hands-on corroboration of the cloud free tier specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: Always free — 1 cluster per user, upgrade to paid anytime.
You can easily start Weaviate and a local vector embedding model with Docker.
It is open source and fairly easy to get running locally
